description: This source file implements a command-line utility for tracing and executing multiple Torch Mobile models, recording operator usage, kernel data types, and custom classes, then outputting this information in YAML format.

methods.name: printOpYAML
methods.description: Outputs YAML formatted information for a single operator, including usage for training, root status, and overload inclusion.

methods.name: printOpsYAML
methods.description: Outputs YAML for a list of operators, calling printOpYAML for each.

methods.name: printDTypeYAML
methods.description: Outputs YAML formatted data types for a kernel tag.

methods.name: printDTypesYAML
methods.description: Outputs YAML for all kernel data types, iterating over kernel tags.

methods.name: printCustomClassesYAML
methods.description: Outputs YAML list of loaded custom classes.
